dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the posterior lateral flank are 3-5 irregular high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shapes with sharp pixel-level transitions from a dark-value exterior to a high-luminance white perimeter; these structures exhibit jagged, non-linear edge geometries with varying stroke widths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and interspersed between the macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface, lacking internal luminosity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the posterior flank form an elongated scalene triangle, while smaller high-intensity blobs create a secondary linear chain extending toward the posterior flipper region.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly specific reticulated network of high-contrast pixels connects two macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal surface, creating a distinct bridge-like visual structure.
